targetCompanyImage.name: I-66 Express Mobility Partners, LLC
targetCompanyImage.description: I-66 Express Mobility Partners is the concessionaire for the 66 Express Outside the Beltway project in Northern Virginia. Its users are commuters, freight operators, and other motorists traveling the I-66 corridor between the Capital Beltway and Prince William County. The project follows a long-term public-private concession model under which the consortium designed, financed, built, operates, and maintains priced express lanes and related roadway improvements. Public materials describe a $3.7 billion, 22.5-mile managed-lanes project delivered under a 50-year agreement with the Virginia Department of Transportation. The lanes opened in 2022 and the project includes highway, transit, and corridor-improvement components across one of the region's most congested corridors. The consortium is publicly described as including Cintra, Meridiam, and APG, while current ownership percentages are not publicly disclosed.
